import { Body, Controller, Get, Param, Post, Query, Res } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PartialType } from '@nestjs/mapped-types';
import { IsOptional, IsString, MaxLength } from 'class-validator';
import { Column, Entity, PrimaryGeneratedColumn } from 'typeorm';

export class BaseNoteDto {
  @IsOptional()
  clientRequestId?: string;
}

export class CreateNoteDto extends BaseNoteDto {
  // CASE:contract-dto-fields
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(120)
  title!: string;

  @IsOptional()
  summary?: string;
}

// CASE:contract-mapped-type
export class UpdateNoteDto extends PartialType(CreateNoteDto) {}

export interface ImportNoteDto {
  title: string;
  source: string;
}

export interface LegacyNoteDto {
  title: string;
  legacyCode: number;
}

export class NoteViewDto {
  id!: number;
  title!: string;
}

@Entity('note')
export class Note {
  // CASE:contract-entity-columns
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id!: number;

  @Column({
    name: 'note_title',
    length: 120,
    transformer: {
      to: (value: string) => value.trim(),
      from: (value: string) => value,
    },
  })
  title!: string;

  @Column({ name: 'internal_code', select: false, update: false })
  internalCode!: string;
}

function LocalBody(): ParameterDecorator {
  return () => undefined;
}

@Controller('tenants/:tenantId/notes')
export class NotesController {
  // CASE:contract-request-sources
  @Post()
  create(
    @Param('tenantId') tenantId: string,
    @Body() dto: CreateNoteDto,
    @Query('dryRun') dryRun?: string,
  ): Promise<NoteViewDto> {
    void tenantId;
    void dto;
    void dryRun;
    return Promise.resolve(new NoteViewDto());
  }

  // CASE:contract-body-selector
  @Post('title')
  createTitle(@Body('title') title: string): NoteViewDto {
    void title;
    return new NoteViewDto();
  }

  // CASE:contract-ambiguous-body
  @Post('import')
  import(@Body() dto: ImportNoteDto | LegacyNoteDto): NoteViewDto {
    void dto;
    return new NoteViewDto();
  }

  // CASE:contract-manual-response
  @Get('manual')
  manual(@Res() response: { json(value: unknown): void }): void {
    response.json({ ok: true });
  }

  // CASE:contract-local-lookalike
  localDecorator(@LocalBody() value: string): string {
    return value;
  }

  // CASE:contract-any-response
  @Get('untyped')
  untyped(): any {
    return { value: 'runtime' };
  }
}
